name: Citizens Summit Reserve World Elite Mastercard

localized_names.en: Citizens Summit Reserve World Elite Mastercard

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: Waived for Citizens Private Client checking and Private Bank customers; reduced to $95 for customers with a Citizens Quest checking relationship.

apr.notes: 19.49% to 28.49% variable APR on purchases and balance transfers. Cash advance APR 28.49%. Balance transfer fee $10 or 5%, whichever is greater. No penalty APR.

base_rate.description: Unlimited 1.5% cash back on everything else.

benefits.title: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck credit
benefits.description: Credit of up to $120 for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck every 4.5 years.

benefits.title: Priority Pass membership
benefits.description: Priority Pass membership with four free lounge visits each year.

benefits.title: Annual travel credits
benefits.description: Up to $120 in annual statement credits when you charge $10 or more on eligible travel purchases.

benefits.title: Lyft credit
benefits.description: $10 statement credit each month you spend $25 or more on Lyft rides.
